steps.name: Brief
steps.body: You tell me what the business does, who it's for and when you need it. A short call or a WhatsApp chat is enough.

steps.name: Scope
steps.body: I send a written plan: pages or features, timeline and price. Nothing starts until you approve it.

steps.name: Build
steps.body: You get a live preview link in week one, then updates as it grows. Your feedback goes into the next round.

steps.name: Launch and handover
steps.body: I put it on your domain, connect analytics, and hand over the code, the logins and a short guide.
